# XMG NEO 16 2026 roadmap — SRC-0281

## Sources

- https://www.xmg.gg/en/news-computex-2026-xmg-pro-18/
- https://www.xmg.gg/en/news-roadmap-2026-q2-xmg-roadmap/
- https://help.xmg.gg/hc/en-gb/articles/17824549043741
- https://help.xmg.gg/hc/en-gb/sections/18109528329629-System-updates

## Evidence

XMG officially announced a 2026 NEO 16 refresh based on the existing chassis with Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus and RTX 5070 Ti, 5080 or 5090. Planned displays are a matte Mini-LED at 2560x1600, 750-nit SDR/1000-nit HDR and full P3, plus a 500-nit SDR full-P3 OLED option. Launches were scheduled across August–September 2026, but as of this check XMG still publishes no final price, exact configuration or availability. Therefore it is a genuine upcoming current-year family, not yet a transaction.

The firmware concern is nuanced: XMG states that Windows Update normally supplies many drivers and considers automatic driver updates generally useful, while model-specific BIOS/EC updates are handled through XMG's download/help workflow. The claim that XMG has no OS-delivered drivers at all is false; the concern that firmware servicing is more manual and less integrated than Dell/Lenovo remains valid.
